name: tornado-engine/github
description: Tornado Engine module: connect a GitHub account, and publish modules to GitHub (private or public) and Packagist.

tornado.name: GitHub
tornado.prompt: publish_module publishes a module to GitHub (and Packagist, to share it with other districts). work_on_module gives you a working copy of an installed module this site maintains (the connected GitHub account can push to its repository), to change it and publish a new version. patch_file changes a file of Core or an installed module this site doesn't maintain through the district's patch, which goes back on after every update.
